notes.title: Small graphics and gameplay Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow humans. Today I bring you a few changes and additions to your secretly favorite game, Hollow Destiny:
- New slightly changed sprites.
- New effects.
- Changed the necessary amount of fragments to create a Glimpse from 50 to 20.
- New meme based drawing for advertisement.

Hope you all enjoy the changes =)
